## 7. Limitations

- Service thresholds are derived (departure + H); explicit Amazon time windows are too sparse to evaluate routing.
- Lateness labels propagate the historical driver sequence with mean travel times and planned service times.
- Travel-time scenarios are synthetic, independent edge-level lognormal noise; distances are Haversine proxies.
- Test routes come from the latest calendar dates of one season (2018); stations are not held out.
